literal_meaning: ব্যবসায়ী বা বণিক (merchant or trader, referring to the Bania caste)
figurative_meaning_bn: মন্দার্থে- প্রবল ব্যবসায়ীবুদ্ধিসম্পন্ন লোক, লাভ লোকসান সম্পর্কে মাত্রাতিরিক্ত সতর্ক লোক
figurative_meaning_en: In a negative sense - a shrewd, business-savvy person who is excessively cautious about profit and loss
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ে তার মতো বানিয়া আর কেউ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a real Bania when it comes to making a profit.
No one is as shrewd a businessman as him in deals.
history: Refers to the Bania community, a traditional merchant caste in Indian society with roots in ancient trade practices and Hindu varna system.
note: The term carries a pejorative connotation in modern usage, stereotyping merchants as overly calculating.
